places.name: Lounah Allée Bleue (Franschhoek)
places.hours: Mon-Tue closed, Wed-Fri 08:00-16:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-15:00 (Instagram says Wed-Sun 08:00-15:00: confirm)

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Emily R.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: I love the atmosphere of tranquility and the trees combined with the swings are so inviting.  This is the perfect spot to have a coffee and read a book by yourself or to enjoy having a catch up with friends.

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Petra V.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Beautiful lunch spot, excellent food, tranquil atmosphere, great service!

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Abigail N.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Lounah Café has the friendliest staff, warmest atmosphere and most beautiful decor. I keep returning because nothing beats it.

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Rivonia N.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: We've just absolutely fallen in love with Lounah Cafe in Paarl. It's just a part of my heart in a restaurant 🌻🫶🏽 delicious food and great service.

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Eleanora B.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: What a yummy place. Everything on the menu looked inviting. And the carrot cake is a 10/10! Coffee superb. Friendly fast service !

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Hendri B.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Love sitting at the back between the trees! They honey cake is the Best!!

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Melanie P.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: The back courtyard, with beautiful private areas are absolutely what the soul needs. ❤️

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Margot N.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: We hosted my sister's kitchen tea at Lounah Café this weekend and had the most wonderful experience. Mia was incredibly helpful over email leading up to the event.

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Gerda
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Lovely cozy café. Best fresh cakes (especially if you're a carrot cake fan and you're very particular about carrot cake icing)

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Joe A.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: I came from the UK, this place is beautiful! Posh coffee and cake!

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Jan H.
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Lovely spot for coffee & brunch. Delicious food & first class service.

curated_reviews_for_site.author: Deene Social
curated_reviews_for_site.text: Such a beautiful new spot in Franschhoek! The food was absolutely delicious, the coffee was epic and the setting at Allée Bleue is hard to beat.
